"The opening up of the New World through Spanish discovery led to an unprecedented expansion of global trade. Enormous quantities of silver bullion extracted from the mines of Potosi in Peru and Mexico flowed into Europe and thence across the Ottoman Empire, Safavid Persia, and via European maritime companies into Mughal India.
